messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had hardly closed my eyes when I awoke to the sound of rain banging on the roof and the sound of my alarm going off at 7:30 am.

output.original_text: I had hardly closed my eyes when I awoke to the sound of rain banging on the roof and the sound of my alarm going off at 7:30 am.
output.joy: I had just fallen asleep when I joyfully awoke to the sound of rain dancing on the roof and my cheerful alarm ringing at 7:30 am.
output.sadness: I had hardly closed my eyes when I slowly awoke to the sound of rain pounding on the roof and my relentless alarm going off at 7:30 am.
output.fear: I had hardly closed my eyes when I jolted awake to the ominous sound of rain hammering on the roof and my alarm blaring at 7:30 am.
output.anger: I had barely closed my eyes when I was rudely awakened by the relentless rain banging on the roof and my alarm screeching at 7:30 am.
output.surprise: I had just closed my eyes when I was suddenly awakened by the unexpected sound of rain thundering on the roof and my alarm going off at 7:30 am!
output.disgust: I had hardly closed my eyes when I was disgustingly jolted awake by the sound of rain crashing on the roof and my irritating alarm going off at 7:30 am.
